camera_conversion.front_convention: official in_frustum keeps corners with camera-space z > 0.2
camera_conversion.intrinsics: project benchmark convention: JSON fov is vertical FOV; derive K, FoVx and FoVy from width/height/focal
camera_conversion.official_matrix_convention: world_view_transform = inverse(converted camera_to_world).T; projection_matrix matches CityGaussian utils.graphics_utils.getProjectionMatrix(...).T; full_proj_transform = world_view_transform @ projection_matrix for row-vector homogeneous corners
camera_conversion.project_conversion: flip camera Y/Z axes and multiply translation by scale_ratio
camera_conversion.selection_policy: np.linspace over [0, 1439] with sample_count=12, rounded to nearest integer, deduplicated, and sorted; includes first and final frames.

paper_policy.status: provisional; included as separate fixture only

release_policy.average_scale_statistic: max(mean(activated_scaling[cell_mask], dim=0)) per cell and level
release_policy.distance_definition: minimum Euclidean camera-space distance over the eight MAD-bound cell corners
release_policy.fallback_behavior: when no level matches, lod_idx = len(lod_list) - 1
release_policy.level_order: render_large_lod.py loads dataset.lod_configs in YAML order
release_policy.selection_order: first matching YAML-order level via torch.max over uint8 boolean comparisons
release_policy.visibility_source_level: render_lod uses lod_list[-1].cell_corners, i.e. the last/coarsest level

unresolved_semantics: Paper fixed intervals are reported in world units/meters, but compatibility with the current project Viser-path scale_ratio camera conversion has not been validated against official renders.
Boundary convention is encoded as half-open [0,200), [200,400), [400,inf) for this provisional oracle.
